ruleset.name: Eurotech EJCS - Basic Integrity
ruleset.description: Eurotech Java Coding Standard (PR1067), Basic Integrity: every rule except clause 5.11

rule.name: EJCS-X01-LoopWithMultipleExits
rule.message: EJCS-002: a loop shall contain no more than one break or continue
rule.description: More than one break or continue targeting the same loop.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //(ForStatement | ForeachStatement | WhileStatement | DoStatement) [ let $loop := . return count(.//BreakStatement [ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::SwitchStatement][1] is $loop]) + count(.//ContinueStatement [ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement][1] is $loop]) > 1 ]

rule.name: EJCS-X02-JumpOutOfFinally
rule.message: EJCS-004: break or continue shall not leave a finally block
rule.description: break or continue in a finally block whose target lies outside that block.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FinallyClause//BreakStatement [ let $f := ancestor::FinallyClause[1] return not(ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::SwitchStatement][1][ancestor::FinallyClause[1] is $f]) ] | //FinallyClause//ContinueStatement [ let $f := ancestor::FinallyClause[1] return not(ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement][1][ancestor::FinallyClause[1] is $f]) ]

rule.name: EJCS-X03-DirectRecursion
rule.message: EJCS-006: a method shall not call itself
rule.description: Call whose target is statically the enclosing method: same name and arity, and unqualified, this-qualified, qualified by the enclosing class name, or made on an expression of the enclosing class type. Calls through an interface or superclass that may dispatch back are indirect recursion and are found by the call-graph scan. An overload of equal arity is also reported; that over-report is intended.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall [@MethodName = ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1]/@Name] [count(ArgumentList/*) = ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1]/@Arity] [ let $cls := string(ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration][1]/@BinaryName) return not(*[1][not(self::ArgumentList)]) or *[1][self::ThisExpression] or ($cls != '' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs($cls)]) ]

rule.name: EJCS-X04-FloatingPointLoopCounter
rule.message: EJCS-007: a loop control variable shall not be of floating-point type
rule.description: for loop whose control variable is float or double.

rule.name: EJCS-X05-FinalizeOverride
rule.message: EJCS-010: finalize() shall not be overridden
rule.description: Declaration of finalize() with no parameters.

rule.name: EJCS-X06-InterruptedExceptionSwallowed
rule.message: EJCS-011: an InterruptedException handler shall restore the interrupt or rethrow
rule.description: Handler of InterruptedException that neither calls interrupt() nor throws.

rule.name: EJCS-X07-LockNotReleasedInFinally
rule.message: EJCS-012: lock() shall be followed immediately by try with unlock() in finally
rule.description: Lock.lock() or lockInterruptibly() not immediately followed by a try statement whose finally block calls unlock() on the same lock.

rule.name: EJCS-X08-WaitOutsideLoop
rule.message: EJCS-012: wait() shall be called in synchronized code, inside a while loop
rule.description: Object.wait() not enclosed in a while or do loop and in synchronized code of the same method.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall [pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Object#wait()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Object#wait(long)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Object#wait(long,int)')] [ let $m := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression][1] return not(ancestor::*[self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement][ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression][1] is $m]) or not(ancestor::SynchronizedStatement[ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression][1] is $m] or $m[self::MethodDeclaration][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'synchronized']) ]

rule.name: EJCS-X09-LocalShadowsField
rule.message: EJCS-014: a local variable shall not have the name of a field of its class
rule.description: Local variable named as a field declared in the enclosing class body. Parameters are not reported.

rule.name: EJCS-X11-FloatingPointEquality
rule.message: EJCS-015: floating-point values shall not be compared with == or !=
rule.description: == or != with a float or double operand.

rule.name: EJCS-X12-BigDecimalFromDouble
rule.message: EJCS-015: a BigDecimal shall not be constructed from a double
rule.description: new BigDecimal(...) whose first argument is float or double.

rule.name: EJCS-X15-DiscardedStatusResult
rule.message: EJCS-017: the status result of this method shall not be discarded
rule.description: Call used as a statement, to a method whose result reports whether the operation succeeded or how much it did.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ExpressionStatement/MethodCall [ pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#delete()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#mkdir()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#mkdirs()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#renameTo(java.io.File)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#createNewFile()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#setLastModified(long)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#setReadable(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#setWritable(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.File#setExecutable(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.InputStream#read(byte[])') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.InputStream#read(byte[],int,int)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.InputStream#skip(long)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.Reader#read(char[])') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.Reader#read(char[],int,int)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.io.Reader#skip(long)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.Queue#offer(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue#offer(_,long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock#tryLock(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition#await(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition#awaitNanos(long)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition#awaitUntil(java.util.Date)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore#tryAcquire(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch#await(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService#awaitTermination(long,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.sql.ResultSet#next()') ]

rule.name: EJCS-X17-PublicMutableField
rule.message: EJCS-023: a public field shall be static and final
rule.description: public field that is not both static and final (implicit interface modifiers count).
